title: BATWA v2.4.14 Official Release
message: Naya update live ho chuka hai! Tamam 38 Pakistani verified commercial banks, microfinance banks aur digital wallets ke exact official logos aur 1Link transfer support ke sath app live hai.
features: Full suite of 38 Pakistani banks and digital wallets with verified official logos

Commercial Banks: HBL, Meezan, UBL, Alfalah, MCB, ABL, Bank AL Habib, Askari, Faysal, NBP, SCB, BOP, BOK, DIB, Al Baraka, Soneri, JS Bank, HabibMetro, Samba, BankIslami, BML, FWBL, Sindh Bank, Silkbank, MCB Islamic
Microfinance Banks: ABHI Microfinance, ZTBL, Advans, MMBL, Apna Bank, UPaisa (U Bank)
Digital Wallets & EMIs: Easypaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay, NayaPay, aik by BankIslami, Zindigi by JS Bank
1Link title inquiry and direct IBFT transfers across all 38 financial institutions
Interactive website marquee showcasing all partner banking and payment institutions
100% clean UI: vertical Batwa Black Edition card, compact analytics, no pig references
changelog: Restored and verified all 38 Pakistani banks & wallets in Bank Transfer selection
Integrated authentic bank logos across mobile app and web marquee
Updated fallback resolver for all bank IDs and clearing codes
Deployed release APK v2.4.14 (Build 254) to production server
